contact_extra_allowed_note: 2026-11-06 operator-approved waiver (option C). After the controller right-arm tool was redefined (tcp3 pose -5.049/-29.898/167.789 mm: 25.1 mm in Y and 16.6 mm in Z away from the pose every October run used) the 230 mm lift grazed a measured protrusion by 0.44 mm (contact segment 0.36 mm) and the run fail-closed with CONTACT_TOOL_NON_TARGET_WORLD_COLLISION. That cuboid is built from only 6-8 measured points (13x22x8 mm + 7 mm inflation) and sits 8-10 mm from the grasp TCP, so it stays below the >=30 point bar of the CONTACT_OBSERVED_OCCUPANCY_V2 measured-protrusion refinement and remains a solid hard box. The operator chose to explicitly allow contact with it rather than relax the refinement gate. Scope: only the matched primitive is appended to motion_constraints.ignore_cuboid_ids (the same mechanism the detected target already uses); every other object stays hard. The waiver is anchored by body-frame centre because support_decomposition renumbers primitives on every scan (the same speck was ..._014 at 11:42 and ..._015 at 11:53, 2.1 mm apart); contact_extra_allowed_object_ids stays empty for exactly that reason.
